create_multioutput_regressor: create a multioutput regressor that fits one regressor per target variable using a base estimator
create_multioutput_classifier: create a multioutput classifier that fits one classifier per target variable independently
build_classifier_chain: build a classifier chain that arranges binary classifiers into a chain using predictions from earlier models
build_regressor_chain: build a regressor chain that arranges regressions into a chain using cross-validated predictions
test_multioutput_partial_fit: test incremental fitting of multioutput models using partial_fit with sample weights and classes
